europe_now.title: EU Leaders Tussle Over Ukraine Peace Talks Representation
europe_now.summary: European Union leaders are divided over who should represent them in upcoming peace negotiations regarding Ukraine and Russia. US envoys have held discussions in Moscow before traveling to meet with Ukrainian leadership.

sources.headline: EU leaders tussle over who to send to Ukraine, Russia peace talks

europe_now.title: Ukrainian Drone Strikes Russian Warship
europe_now.summary: A Russian warship was reportedly hit by a Ukrainian drone operating in the Gulf of Finland. The incident marks another security escalation in the regional conflict.

sources.headline: Russian warship hit by Ukrainian drone in Gulf of Finland
